gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.
